static_traits.name: Liu Dylan
static_traits.social_status: Has one supportive friend,但尚not yet与其分享这些感受;与伴侣关系因not安全感而紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without明显躯体疾病;without心理治疗史;既往not yet出现类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,能具体描述情境与感受;配合度Good;倾向过度分析与Self-doubt;在涉及与伴侣沟通时显现犹豫与回避;整体语气中性

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得伴侣可能因为我喜欢红酒而not是白酒而认为我not够有品味,这导致我产生not安全感和Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的not安全感和Self-doubt开始影响我的日常生活和关系,这促使我寻求咨询.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on the views of others(尤其伴侣的评价)

special_situations.event: At a dinner a few months ago, my partner ordered white wine while I ordered red wine
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的偏好与伴侣not同,伴侣就会觉得我not够有品味,从而看低我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与伴侣讨论真实感受;在事后not断过度分析该情境以试图掌控被评判的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他/她会觉得我not够讲究,not够有品味

special_situations.event: In social settings or when making decisions together with the partner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我做出与他人not同的选择,do not人都会把这归因于I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在社交中谨小慎微,Suppressing expression偏好,试图减少被看见与被评判的机会
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone is scrutinizing my choices and labeling me accordingly

special_situations.event: 想到与伴侣开启沟通时(准备谈及not安全感与Self-doubt)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达not安与Self-doubt,就会被认为软弱或not够好,从而被negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids starting conversations, delays communication to reduce possible embarrassment or judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I say it, he/she will look down on me

special_situations.event: 回忆伴侣在选酒上的not同偏好并据此推断对我整体的看法
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次偏好差异等同于对我整体素质的negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores the partner's past support and positive behavior, focusing only on differences to verify worries
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这又是一个让我显得not够好的证据

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被伴侣接纳与认可(希望自己的偏好被理解且not被评判)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被看低,被negate与被评判,从而价值被动摇
defense_goal: 通过回避沟通与过度分析来维持安全感,减少被直接negate的可能

object_relations.self_representation: A self easily judged, needing its worth proven
object_relations.object_representation: A picky partner who judges me based on subtle preferences

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请与伴侣就not安全感开展开放沟通,或被探索其'被评判'的念头来源时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识将开放沟通体验为可能被negate或被看低的场景(移情:把过度担忧的'他人评判'Projection到伴侣与咨询情境)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气审慎,逻辑化表达,强调not确定与假设性措辞;减少情感性词汇与自我揭露,避免直接表达需求或脆弱感.

manifestations: 与伴侣的关系因not安全感而紧张
In social settings, feels scrutinized and finds it hard to express real preferences
尚not yet与支持性的朋友讨论此事,倾向独自承受
outcomes: Decreased enjoyment of life(园艺兴趣受影响)

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Attributes worries about 'being looked down on / judged' to the partner's choices and thoughts
In social and joint decision-making, assumes others will evaluate oneself negatively

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: In social situations, over-analyzes one's choices and image
Hesitates to start a conversation with the partner, worries vulnerability will be looked down on

exception_events.target_problem: 在与伴侣共同生活与社交的情境中,来访者通常会将偏好差异视为被评判的证据,从而not安全感加重并回避沟通.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 伴侣在Work与园艺方面一直给予支持与帮助,这些互动中并not yet出现评判,关系体验更为正向.
exception_events.reason: Clues: the partner provides support and cooperation through action in specific matters; the situation focuses on common interests and daily help, weakening the 'being judged' interpretive framework, enabling the client to notice positive evidence.

positive_force: Partner's continued support for work and hobbies
Having a supportive friend as a resource
Positive qualities in self-perception (diligence, supporting others, striving to be a good partner and good parent)
negative_force: 心理过滤,读心术,个人化等认知偏差Reinforcement被评判的主线故事
Over-analysis and avoiding communication leading to a problem cycle
Self-doubt与not安全感高企,容易忽视正向证据

target_behavior.behavior: 在Social situations与与伴侣共同决策时的强烈not安全感与Self-doubt,并回避开启沟通
antecedent: When dining out with the partner or choosing preferences together
When needing to make personal choices in social settings
target_behavior.core_reason: 将偏好差异解读为对自我价值与品味的negate,形成灾难化的'被评判'Anticipation与过度Self-monitoring
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的批评或negate,以维持短期的心理安全感
target_behavior.consequence: 伴侣Relationship tension,沟通减少;Daily life affected(爱好园艺的享受下降);持续的not安全感与Self-doubt
